card.name: Small words in hair-treatment instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (then, a, of, to) in directions for applying products to hair or scalp, especially lice lotions, and in other hair or salon text. It fires just before the model would name hair-care actions or items like comb or styling.

modes.label: Lice lotion directions
modes.description: Linking words in steps for applying, leaving on, rinsing and combing out hair-treatment lotions.
modes.example: Leave on for 10 minutes,<< then>> thoroughly rinse off with warm water.

modes.label: Other hair text
modes.description: Words in general passages about hair, such as salons, hair collection or graying.
modes.example: Did your hair<< turn>> gray before age 35?

card.writes: It pushes toward hair-care words such as styling, comb, salon and combing.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in hair-treatment directions, where a hair-care word like comb or rinse is likely to come next.
